headline: Law keeps the Chesapeake and Ohio Canal National Historical Park Commission running until October 1, 2031.
what_it_does: This law extends the life of the Chesapeake and Ohio Canal National Historical Park Commission so it can keep operating until October 1, 2031. The official summary does not describe any other changes to the commission or the park.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Chesapeake and Ohio Canal National Historical Park Commission
who_it_affects.how: They can keep serving on the commission until October 1, 2031, instead of having it end sooner.

who_it_affects.group: National Park Service staff who manage the Chesapeake and Ohio Canal National Historical Park
who_it_affects.how: They can keep working with the commission through October 1, 2031.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 23, 2024; the commission is extended until October 1, 2031.
